summary: Victory Pay LIGHT green fintech redesign + payment-flow iteration tested end-to-end. Backend: 33/33 pytest tests PASSED against the public preview URL. Covered: auth (register w/ ₹70 signup bonus + duplicate + login + admin login + google invalid + me/logout), referrals (₹300 credit + endpoint), GET /api/config (telegram + beneficiary_name + payment_method + usdt_address), GET /api/rates/usdt-inr (numeric live/fallback), GET /api/tasks (exactly 35 tasks across L1..L7 with 5 each; rates 0.020..0.035 per level; every task has amount/rate/reward/bonus=10/final/quantity/code; L5 task with amount 1546 yields reward 43.29 and final 1599.29), GET /api/wallet/upi-info (beneficiary_name + payment_method + big_payment_upi='harsh.g216@ptyes' + usdt_address + qr_images len 2), POST /api/tasks/pay validation (missing screenshot -> 400 'screenshot', UTR <6 chars -> 400 'utr'), POST /api/tasks/pay OK with utr+remarks+currency=INR (credit = task.final = 1599.29, screenshot scrubbed from response) and with currency=USDT+usdt_amount, screenshot viewable in GET /api/admin/payments, admin approve credits balance by task.final (1599.29) and total_earned by reward (43.29), admin reject leaves balance untouched, payout accounts CRUD (UPI validation), wallet withdraw (invalid account/insufficient/OK), admin approve deducts balance, support chat + admin threads/reply + non-admin 403 on admin endpoints, live stats. Full e2e (test_70): login test1@example.com -> pay L5 amount 1546 with utr='123456789012' + base64 screenshot -> admin approve -> balance increased by exactly 1599.29 (1546+43.29+10). Frontend (mobile viewport 390x844): intro -> landing (landing-login-button) -> login (email/password/submit) -> home (home-balance shows ₹1,669.29) -> Buy RP (all 7 levels rendered L1..L7, 5 receive-<taskid> buttons for active level) -> Payment screen (ALL 9 testIDs present: currency-inr, currency-usdt, payment-qr, change-qr-button, payment-utr-input, payment-remarks-input, upload-screenshot-button, warning-box, payment-submit-button; currency toggle + change-QR both interactive; UTR input accepts text; QR image loads) -> Sell RP (sell-withdraw-button, sell-add-wallet-button, sell-empty all present; empty state shown) -> Mine (mine-balance, copy-invite-button, logout-button; open-admin-button correctly hidden for non-admin). No red screens, no runtime errors. Deprecated packages detected: none — only RN-Web style deprecation warnings ('shadow*' -> boxShadow; props.pointerEvents -> style.pointerEvents) which are cosmetic.

react_native_issues.issue: RN-Web console warning: '"shadow*" style props are deprecated. Use "boxShadow"'. Migrate shadowColor/shadowOffset/shadowOpacity/shadowRadius to boxShadow (or elevation for android). Reference: /app/frontend/src/components/BalanceCard.tsx and any StyleSheet using shadow*.

RN-Web console warning: 'props.pointerEvents is deprecated. Use style.pointerEvents'. Move pointerEvents JSX prop into the style object. Reference: /app/frontend/src/components/AnimatedIntro.tsx, /app/frontend/src/components/Toast.tsx, /app/frontend/app/payment/[taskId].tsx.

action_items: (Cosmetic, non-blocking) Replace shadow* StyleSheet props with `boxShadow` (RN 0.76+) to silence RN-Web deprecation warnings.
(Cosmetic, non-blocking) Move `pointerEvents` JSX prop into `style={{ pointerEvents: 'none' }}` in AnimatedIntro/Toast/pulseRing.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py ~680 lines — approaching the recommended split threshold (700 LOC); consider splitting into modules (auth/admin/wallet/tasks/support/config) soon.
task_payments store base64 screenshot inline in Mongo docs — can bloat documents; consider GridFS or object storage.
admin_payment_action returns 400 for already-processed payments — acceptable behaviour.

success_rate.frontend: 100% (all critical testIDs render across landing/login/home/Buy RP/Payment/Sell RP/Mine; navigation works; auth + payment flows verified)

seed_data_creation: No persistent seed data required. Tests create ephemeral users prefixed with test_. Backend auto-seeds 35 tasks (L1-L7 x 5) + admin on startup. test1@example.com/pass123 idempotently ensured by e2e test.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend regression suite: /app/backend/tests/test_victory_pay.py (pytest-xdist loadscope; shared class state; runs in ~5s). BASE_URL from EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL. Admin creds admin@victorypay.com / Admin@123. Payment screenshot must be >50 chars data URL, UTR must be >=6 chars. For UI tests, intro animation plays for ~3s on every hard reload (page.goto). Tab bar text-based click may fail on stack-navigated (payment) screens; prefer direct URL navigation to /plans, /referrals, /profile between tab tests. Level tab in Buy RP starts on L1; clicking L2..L7 filters cards.
rca_of_issue: N/A — no blocking or functional issues. All 33 backend tests pass; all frontend testIDs (landing/login/home/Buy RP L1-L7/Payment/Sell RP/Mine) verified present and interactive. Only cosmetic RN-Web deprecation warnings for shadow* and pointerEvents styles.
